这里实时求解的是几何光学：斯涅尔定律、真实的水色散曲线、每个界面的菲涅尔透过率，: What runs live here is geometric optics: Snell's law, water's real dispersion curve, Fresnel transmission at every interface, and the area weighting of the incoming beam. The caustic, the step from bright inside to dark outside, and Alexander's band are not painted in — they are what the calculation returns. Three things are deliberate compromises. Geometric optics predicts an infinitely thin bright edge, while the real width comes from the sun's 0.53° disc and from diffraction by the drop; the latter is approximated by the leading Airy scale (λ/a)^(2/3), calibrated so a 10 µm fog droplet smears by about 3°, which is why the fogbow whitens and moves in to roughly 39°. The supernumerary fringes are not drawn. And the broad glow inside the bow is held down on purpose, because this model contains no ordinary skylight, whereas a real sky gets most of its background brightness from scattered daylight. The trends are trustworthy, but this is not a full Airy or Mie solution.
这里实时算的是涡丝模型：每个环用 64 段折线表示，用去奇异化的毕奥–萨伐尔核（: What runs live here is a vortex filament model: each ring is 64 straight segments, they induce velocity on one another through a desingularized Biot–Savart kernel (1/r³ replaced by 1/(r²+a²)^{3/2}), and the smoke particles are passively carried by that same velocity field. The self-propulsion, the leapfrog and the smaller-is-faster rule are not scripted — they are what the calculation returns, and the ring speed agrees with the thin-core formula to within about twenty percent. But this is not a Navier–Stokes solution: there is no viscosity, no core deformation and no real instability or breakup, so the rings never shake themselves apart the way real smoke rings finally do. The core thickness is a fixed parameter rather than something that evolves, and the timescale is set for comfortable watching.

每个词都准备三样东西：一份「询问」Q（我想找什么）、一块「招牌」K（我是什么）、: Every token prepares three things: a query Q (“what am I looking for?”), a key K (“what am I?”), and a value V (“what information do I carry?”). Its query is dotted with the key of every token to its left to produce a row of scores. Dividing by √d keeps the scale stable, and softmax normalizes the scores so each token’s attention weights always sum to 1. Finally, the value vectors are mixed according to those weights and folded into the token’s representation. Attention = softmax(QKᵀ/√d)·V.
这样的「打分—混合」在每个头里独立进行，各头学各的分工：有的盯相邻词，有的跨句找: This score-and-mix process runs independently in every head, and each head learns a different job: one watches neighboring tokens, one tracks references across the sentence, one links subjects and verbs, and one looks back to the beginning. At the end of a layer, each token carries its newly blended information into the next. After three layers, the representation of “it” already contains information from “kitten.” The 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need brought this mechanism to center stage; GPT, Claude, and DeepSeek are all built on the Transformer architecture it introduced.

平面上的曼德博集合来自迭代 z → z² + c。三维里没有与复数同构的数系，于: The Mandelbrot set in the plane comes from iterating z → z² + c. Three dimensions have no number system isomorphic to the complex numbers, so White and Nylander defined a spherical-coordinate “power”: raise the radius r to the pth power, multiply the polar angle θ and azimuth φ by p, then iterate z → zᵖ + c, still using an escape radius of 2. To render it, a ray marches from every screen pixel and uses the distance estimate DE = ½·log r·r/dr to find the fractal surface. The soft shadows and ambient occlusion come from the same distance field—the light and dark relief you see is the shape of this formula.

In 2009, Daniel White proposed a spherical-coordinate approach on the Fractal Forums under the idea “not uniquely correct, just beautiful enough.” Paul Nylander identified the classic power-8 form and documented a rendering method. The open-source community—including Mandelbulber and Mandelbulb 3D—then turned it into a real-time renderer you can dive through.

Evaporation feeds vapour into the air; when it condenses inside clouds it releases the heat absorbed at the surface — central pressure falls, surrounding air rushes in, and within days scattered thunderstorm clusters organise into spiral rainbands with a clear eye at the centre. The colour of the sea is this engine’s fuel gauge.

Switch it back on: moving air keeps deflecting to the right in the northern hemisphere, bending the inflow into a counterclockwise spiral that sustains itself. The southern hemisphere is the mirror image (clockwise); within 5° of the equator the Coriolis force is almost zero — typhoons never form there.
跟上气流完成一次循环：低空暖湿空气以约 20° 的入流角螺旋扑向中心，沿十几公里: Follow the airflow through one full cycle: warm moist air spirals inward at an inflow angle of about 20°, climbs violently up the ten-plus-kilometre eyewall, then fans out at the cloud tops; some air folds back and sinks inside the eye, warming as it descends — which is why the eye is calm and open to the sea, while the eyewall around it is the most violent part of the storm.

The updraft weakens, the eye fills in, the spiral relaxes back into scattered cloud clusters. A passing typhoon also leaves a cold wake 1–4 °C cooler on the sea surface that lingers for days. Its whole life lasts about a week: born over the warm pool, dead over cold water.

Every little needle only follows its neighbours — lining up is the comfortable state — while heat keeps shaking them, trying to scatter the ranks. Cool it down and following starts to snowball: one small patch of agreement drags its neighbours in, growing bigger and bigger, until the nail can be held up again.

The exact temperature where the two forces tie is the critical point — domains shatter into flickering flakes of every size, blooming and dying. Magnetism does not fade away gradually; the whole magnet turns at this one line.

波在墙内每深一点就弱一截，可只要墙不够厚，出口处就还剩一丝丝。现在一颗一颗地看：: The wave fades with every step deeper, yet a trace remains at the exit. Now watch one electron at a time: each lands whole, on one side or the other — keep an eye on the right as the wall thickens.
把同一堵墙换成针尖与金属表面之间的一层薄真空：针尖扫过表面，离原子越近，穿过去的: Turn that same wall into a thin vacuum gap between a needle tip and a metal surface: as the tip scans across, the closer it sits to an atom, the more electrons cross. Line by line the image develops and atoms emerge one by one — this is how the scanning tunneling microscope sees single atoms, and it earned the 1986 Nobel Prize in Physics.
发射一颗电子：看它撞墙后被挡回，还是出现在另一边: Fire one electron: see whether it bounces back or appears on the far side
电子为什么能穿过一堵完好的墙？: How can an electron cross an intact wall?
电子不是撞墙的小球，而是一片会延展的波：大部分被挡回，极小一缕漏到另一边。: An electron is not a ball hitting a wall but a wave that spreads: most of it is turned back, while a tiny wisp leaks to the other side.
加厚这堵墙，看右边变安静: Thicken the wall and watch the right side go quiet
舞台上的墙是一维矩形势垒（一片能量更高的区域）的视觉模型：电子能量低于墙高（E/: The wall on stage is a visual model of a one-dimensional rectangular potential barrier (a region of higher energy): the electron’s energy sits below the barrier top (E/V₀ = 0.55), the wave decays as e^(−κx) inside, and the chance for one electron to cross uses the exact formula T = 1/(1 + sinh²(κL)/(4ε(1−ε))). For thicker walls it approaches the textbook T ≈ e^(−2κL) — so doubling the thickness shrinks the probability far more than half.
电子没有挖洞、没有找暗门、没有借能量，也没有瞬移：它在墙内从来不是一颗穿行的小球: The electron does not dig, finds no hidden door, borrows no energy, and never teleports: inside the wall it is never a little ball passing through. The wave describing it is nonzero on both sides, so a measurement has a small chance of finding the whole electron beyond the wall. Macroscopic objects admit the same description — the odds are just too small to happen once in the age of the universe.
为了让微光可见，墙后波的亮度做了增强，数量关系请以读数为准；显微镜场景的原子起伏: To keep the leaked glow visible, the brightness of the transmitted wave is enhanced — trust the readouts, not the brightness, for magnitudes. The microscope scene’s atomic bumps, scan speed, and photo development are illustrative; real instruments record the tunneling current point by point in cryogenic vacuum. This world models a rectangular barrier of finite width and does not represent every real material.

一粒金属盐，突然开花: A Grain of Metal Salt Suddenly Blooms
它没有种子，也没有细胞。金属盐粒落进硅酸盐溶液后，彩色矿物管却会一截一截地向上生: It has no seed and no cells. Yet when a grain of metal salt falls into silicate solution, colored mineral tubes grow upward one segment at a time, like underwater coral waking from sleep.
金属离子一碰到硅酸根，就在金属盐粒表面沉淀成一层薄膜。它把浓溶液包在里面，却仍允: When metal ions meet silicate ions, a thin precipitate membrane forms around the grain. It traps the concentrated solution inside, yet still lets water seep through.
水穿过膜，压力在里面上涨: Water Crosses the Membrane. Pressure Rises Within.
膜内的溶液更浓，水会因渗透作用不断进入。体积想变大，薄膜却拦着它——内压于是像一: The solution inside the membrane is more concentrated, so osmosis keeps drawing water in. The volume tries to expand, but the membrane holds it back — internal pressure builds like one slow breath.
膜一破，喷流把管子向上顶: The Membrane Bursts. A Jet Lifts the Tube.
压力超过薄膜能承受的限度，浓溶液从裂口喷出；这里，较轻的内部溶液受浮力偏向上升，: Once the pressure exceeds what the membrane can withstand, concentrated solution jets through a tear. Here, the lighter inner solution tends to rise under buoyancy while precipitation continues where the jet meets the outer solution, leaving a hollow mineral tube behind.
无生命的盐，长成一座花园: Lifeless Salt Grows into a Garden
在一些条件下，膜会重新封住、压力再次积累，让破裂与生长呈现脉冲式重复。海底热液喷: Under some conditions, the membrane reseals and pressure builds again, making rupture and growth repeat in pulses. Precipitation and flow also build mineral chimneys at seafloor hydrothermal vents; that resemblance is a clue, not proof of how life began.

这是复平面上的一张方格网。公式 e^z 把每个点搬到新位置：竖线一族弯成以原点为: This is a square grid on the complex plane. The formula e^z moves every point to a new address: the vertical family bends into concentric circles around the origin, the horizontal family fans out into rays.
线上每一点的颜色，是它被送去的方向（辐角）。看探针：z 沿竖线向上爬，它的像 e: The color of each point is the direction it is sent to — its argument. Watch the probe: as z climbs the vertical line, its image e^z walks a full lap around the circle.
凑近任何一个十字路口：变形后的网格线仍然垂直相交。这叫共形——复变函数在局部只做: Zoom into any crossing: the warped grid lines still meet at right angles. This is conformality — locally a complex function only rotates and scales, and angles never move.
sin z 把方格压成椭圆与双曲线两族；tan z 更激烈——在 ±π/2 有两: sin z squeezes the grid into two families — ellipses and hyperbolas. tan z is wilder: at ±π/2 sit two poles, where the picture tears open and points are flung to infinity.
sin z 把方格压成椭圆与双曲线两族；tan z 更激烈——±π/2 有两个极: sin z squeezes the grid into two families—ellipses and hyperbolas; tan z goes further, with poles at ±π/2. Stand the plane up: at each pole the modulus races to infinity and grows into a spike.

桌上有一根针，想让它从朝右变成朝左。最直白的办法：按住中点转半圈——能掉头，但针: A needle on the table should face left instead of right. The plainest way: pin its midpoint and spin half a turn—it works, but the needle sweeps a whole disk: π/4 ≈ 0.785.
换个支点，立省一成: Move the pivot, save a tenth
别绕中点转。把针尖轮流挂在等边三角形的三个角上，各抡 60°，三次正好掉头。扫过: Don’t spin around the midpoint. Hang the needle’s tip on each corner of an equilateral triangle in turn, swinging 60° each time—three swings complete the turn. The swept shape is a Reuleaux triangle: (π−√3)/2 ≈ 0.705.
1917 年，挂谷宗一想出一条更绝的轨道：小圆贴着三倍大的圆内壁滚一圈，笔尖就描: In 1917, Sōichi Kakeya found a subtler track: roll a small circle inside one three times its size, and the pen tip traces this three-cusped deltoid.
贴着弧滑，面积砍半: Slide along the arcs, halve the area
这条曲线的神妙之处：任意切线卡在弧里的那段，永远刚好一根针长。针贴壁滑过半圈就掉: The magic of this curve: any tangent clipped by the arcs is always exactly one needle long. Sliding halfway along the wall completes the turn, sweeping π/8 ≈ 0.393—exactly half the disk. Kakeya guessed this was the minimum.
这个猜想撑了十年。把三角形切成越来越细的条，再平移推拢——平移不改变方向，扇面里: The conjecture held for a decade. Slice the triangle into ever thinner strips and slide them together—translation changes no direction, so the fan keeps every direction, yet the combined area drops round after round.
细条之间，蹭着换轨: Brush and switch between the strips
细条被推到互相重叠：针滑进重叠区，小转几度，再滑进下一条。一片细条管 60° 扇: The strips are pushed into overlap: the needle slides into an overlap, turns a few degrees, slides into the next. One bundle covers a 60° fan; three take turns for the full 180°. Cut finer, and the total area shrinks below any bound.
面积可以逼近零，维度却塌不下去——它仍要向四面八方铺开。这就是挂谷猜想；2025: The area can approach zero, but the dimension cannot collapse—it must still spread in every direction. That is the Kakeya conjecture; in 2025, Wang and Zahl proved the three-dimensional case.

切线弦长恒为一根针；扫过 π/8 ≈ 0.393，圆盘的一半。: Every tangent chord is exactly one needle long; sweeps π/8 ≈ 0.393, half the disk.

能不能打出电子由颜色决定，灯再亮也换不来一个电子。: Colour decides whether an electron comes out at all. A brighter lamp buys you nothing.
氢气发出的不是连续彩带，而是几条固定波长的亮线。: Hydrogen emits no continuous ribbon of colour, only a few fixed wavelengths.

位置收得越窄，动量摊得越宽，两者的乘积不肯低于 ℏ/2。: Narrow the position and the momentum fans out; their product refuses to go below ℏ/2.

量子力学的一百年: A hundred years of quantum mechanics
同一张实验台，从 1900 年一直排到今天: One bench, running from 1900 to today
每一站都是当年真实的装置：左边是源，中间是仪器，右边是那块让经典物理算错的屏。: Every stop is the instrument they actually used: the source on the left, the apparatus in the middle, and on the right the screen that classical physics got wrong.
铁只是烧红，答案却是无穷: The iron is merely glowing hot, and the answer comes back infinite
加热它，它先红、再橙、再白。用经典物理算这条光谱，波长越短能量越高，一路冲出画面: Heat it and it turns red, then orange, then white. Compute that spectrum classically and shorter wavelengths carry ever more energy, straight off the top of the chart — yet the real light inside the furnace turns back down at some wavelength. Planck caught it by insisting that energy is handed over in whole units, a step he himself called an act of desperation.
自然界只认整数份: Nature only counts in whole units
换成红光，灯再亮也打不出一个电子；换成紫光，一开灯就有电流——决定权在颜色，不在: Switch to red light and no lamp is bright enough to free a single electron; switch to violet and current flows the moment it is on. Colour decides, brightness does not. Spread out the light of a hydrogen tube and there is no continuous ribbon either, only a few fixed wavelengths. Energy comes in steps, not slopes.
连物质本身也是一段波: Matter itself turns out to be a wave
银原子穿过梯度磁场，屏上没有糊成一片，只有两个点。电子撞上镍晶体，散射出的是衍射: Silver atoms cross a field gradient and the plate does not blur; it grows two spots. Electrons strike a nickel crystal and scatter into a diffraction pattern — at 54 volts an electron’s wavelength is 0.167 nm, the same order as the spacing between atomic planes.
波的平方，是一片概率: Square the wave and you get a probability
海森堡写下一串矩阵，薛定谔写下一个波动方程，两套看上去毫不相干的数学给出了同一组: Heisenberg wrote down arrays of numbers, Schrödinger wrote down a wave equation, and the two notations, which look nothing alike, produced the same ladder of levels. Born added the last line: ψ itself cannot be measured; what you measure is |ψ|², a probability. Einstein never accepted that sentence.
一句反驳，最后变成了一台仪器: An objection that ended up as an instrument
1927 年索尔维会议上玻尔与爱因斯坦开始争论；1935 年爱因斯坦、波多尔斯基: At the 1927 Solvay conference Bohr and Einstein began arguing; in 1935 Einstein, Podolsky and Rosen called the description incomplete; in 1964 Bell turned the argument into an inequality you could measure; experiments in 1972, 1982 and 2015 kept returning the same answer, and the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics closed the file. Today that same physics runs in the chip, the laser and the clock you are holding.

房间里没有别人: No one else is in the room
可那句「你这样不行」还在响。这团光是你的自我——没有观众，它仍在被什么东西从里面: Yet that sentence—“you’re not good enough”—keeps ringing. This glow is your self: no audience, and still something keeps poking it from the inside.
小时候，评价从外面来：一遍，两遍，很多遍。重复够多，它就穿过表面住下——心理学叫: In childhood, judgment comes from outside: once, twice, many times. Repeat it enough and it pierces the surface and settles in—psychologists call it internalization. Children treated harshly at five are more likely to grow self-criticism by twelve.
目光其实只有一半: The gaze is half of what you feel
实验里，穿着尴尬 T 恤的人以为 46% 的观众注意到了自己；一问，只有 23%: In the experiment, people wearing an embarrassing T-shirt guessed 46% of the audience had noticed; when asked, only 23% had. Most of the spotlight you feel is one you switched on yourself—everyone is busy watching themselves.
没被消化的期望靠内疚和焦虑驱动：什么都不做，它也在耗电。越是追着每一句「应该」跑: Undigested expectations run on guilt and anxiety: even when you do nothing, they drain power. The harder you chase every “should”, the faster the light leaks away.
声音不会消失，但被看见、被叫出名字，它就松开了。对自己温柔不是放纵——实验里自我: The voices never vanish, but once seen and named they loosen their grip. Being gentle with yourself is not indulgence—in experiments, self-compassionate people actually persisted longer. Now it’s your turn: tap the thorns inside.
